rules.title: Annual allowable rent increase for rent-controlled units, March 1, 2026 - February 28, 2027
rules.requirement: For rent-controlled units in San Francisco, the annual allowable rent increase from March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6% of the tenant's base rent. The dollar amount is the base rent multiplied by .016.
rules.citation: San Francisco Rent Board annual allowable increase announcement (3/1/26 - 2/28/27)
rules.quoted_span: For rent-controlled units, the annual allowable increase amount effective March 1, 2026 through February 28, 2027 is 1.6%.
rules.extraction_note: Announced by the Rent Board on January 14, 2026; no ordinance section is cited. The 1.6% amount applies through 2027-02-28. The document does not define which units are rent-controlled, so no construction cutoff, unit minimum or exemptions are extracted. The document does not address whether this local rule displaces any statewide cap. The prior 1.4% amount (March 1, 2025 - February 28, 2026) had expired by the query date and is not extracted as a separate rule.
